mguide_1: 1. In order to receive payments from each order, you need to register at Multisafepay
mguide_2: 1.1. Choose the LIVE option / Enter the average monthly revenue generated by your live broadcasts / Insert your website url
mtext_1: Please bear the following information in mind when registering. If the documentation doesn`t cover certain steps, it`s because they`re self-explanatory and you simply need to follow the process.
mtext_2: 2. Next you need to fill in all the required information and choose payment methods that will be available for your shoppers
mtext_3: 3. After that you need to go to “Sites” - “Add new site” and add all the required info in the form
mtext_5: 3.2. Choose the subcategory that suits your business and the good you are selling
mtext_6: 3.3. Add this address in the “Base URL” field -
mtext_7: 4. After adding a website, you need to save info and return to the “Sites” section. You will see the added website in the table and you need to click the key button. Click on it and your key will be copied
